author: Brett Minkin
text: Don’t look at the needle. It looks scary, but it’s honestly not painful at all. Honestly, the worst part is getting the old sensor peeled off.

author: Lou Burrage
text:
You will be ok. My mum was needle phobic so I had to do hers to start with. She soon realised there was nothing to it, it’s just the noise it makes, which you will get used to. 
Sit somewhere calm and quiet, take a big breath and tell yourself ‘I’ve got this’. It will surprise you how easy it is. All the best x
